newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan-May foreign direct investment $6.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan-May foreign direct investment $6.3 bln.

text.p: Brazil's net foreign direct investment in the first five months of 1997 totalled $6.3 billion, the Central Bank said.
The bank said in a statement foreign direct investment only in May amounted to $1.9 billion.
The Central Bank said 49 percent of Brazil's current account balance of payments deficit in the January-to-May period was financed by foreign direct investment.
In the first four months of 1997, foreign direct investment had totalled $4.411 billion.
